lead: A `lang:` feature's perf figure is hashed against its *reference chapter*, so one word changed in `docs/reference/lang/*.md` re-stales every figure in that chapter's group.
body: The repair is one `python tools/dossier.py --record-perf --group '<group>'`, which re-measures only what has no current figure — but it has to come after the session's **last** chapter edit, or it is paid twice, which is what happened here when a proof turned up two stale sentences in the chapter it was proving. Write the proofs, fix the prose, then record.
